description: Which token does this $cashtag mean? Every token using the symbol on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and Solana, most liquid first, with liquidity, 24h volume, first pair date and X account; the top 3 get a risk check (score, verdict, reasons, simulated sell). Catches fake namesakes of a real token. Not advice. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.
